svg.title: Insurance Data Platform technology stack
svg.desc: Tool and logo diagram: Python processes source CSV files and loads Microsoft SQL Server. Python exports a dated aggregate JSON snapshot for Plotly Dash. Apache Airflow orchestrates tasks, scikit-learn supports motor risk scoring, and Docker Compose runs local services.
svg.metadata: Brand icons embedded from Devicon (MIT license). Diagram describes tools used by this repository.
svg.text: The tools behind the insurance platform
SQL data persists in a Docker volume. Dash reads a dated aggregate snapshot.
